abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Cardivel improves blood pressure control compared with Alvenor. Overall, Cardivel and Alvenor reach about the same systolic drop.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Cardivel improves blood pressure control compared with Alvenor. Overall, Cardivel and Alvenor reach about the same systolic drop.
section:
### A further comparison between arms

Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. All data for this comparison were collected at the Maplewood Cardiac Group.

Table 4. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |

| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Blood pressure control | 304 | 450 |
